caption: I’m not a morning person, and I always hated making breakfast in the morning because it was just one more thing I had to do - but I realize that if I’m making a breakfast that I’m truly excited about eating, it makes the mornings that much easier, and it ends up making my breakfast so much more tasty! I try to add at least one serving of fruit and some veggies if I can into breakfast along with some healthy fats and protein because it keeps me full until lunch! #healthyeatingtips #breakfasttips
